entries.text: The pet scan showed no improvement.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I know you're afraid. I know you're afraid to tell me, but you have to tell someone.
entries.speaker: Margaret Scully

entries.text: I'll make a statement right here. Cloning will continue. The human mind will continue to inquire into this. Human cloning will take place, and it'll take place in my lifetime. I think it's right and proper that we continue this kind of inquiry. I think it holds untold benefits for human kind.
entries.speaker: Television Speaker

entries.text: Turn on your television. Are you watching the hearings? Do you see who's there? He's gathering information for who? Our colleague was supposed to have fixed the FBI problem. You will fix it now. Do you understand me? Then I will fix it for good.
entries.speaker: First Elder

entries.text: Agent Mulder, will you please take a seat? Something urgently important has come to the fore. As you're set to testify on your own behalf later today, I've received alarming forensic evidence... From the man's body found in your apartment. I have here in my hand ballistic data... Matching your service weapon, agent Mulder.
entries.speaker: Scott Blevins

entries.text: Where did you get that?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I'm not at liberty to say. But unless you can offer up someone else who might have fired the kill shot, everything points to you as this man's murderer. Are you prepared to give testimony... You're not the man who fired the shot?
entries.speaker: Scott Blevins

entries.text: Why am I here?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: The man worked for the Department of Defense, agent Mulder.
entries.speaker: Scott Blevins

entries.text: The man was spying on me.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Do you know for whom? Agent Scully... Was prepared to name the man at the FBI.. Who was involved in this plot against you and her. We believe she was going to name assistant director Skinner, whom we have learned has been working inside the FBI with a secret agenda.
entries.speaker: Scott Blevins

entries.text: I refuse to believe that.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We've accumulated substantial evidence against him.
entries.speaker: Scott Blevins

entries.text: Can you show it to me?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Mulder, if you name this man today in your testimony, we can file charges against him, charges which may very well exonerate you.
entries.speaker: Scott Blevins

entries.text: Name Skinner and save myself.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's what I called you here to recommend. As a friend.
entries.speaker: Scott Blevins

entries.text: I'll see you at the hearing.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Good morning.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What are you doing here? You have a hearing.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah. I came by last night, but I didn't have the heart to wake you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Came by for what? Mulder, what is it?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I was lost last night. But as I stood here, I thought I'd found my way. I've been, uh-- I've been offered a deal, a deal that could save my life in a way. And though I'd refused the deal earlier, I left here last night with my mind made up to take it.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: A deal with who?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: It doesn't matter. I'm not taking the deal. I'm not taking any deal, not after what happened this morning.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What happened this morning?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Section chief Blevins directed me to implicate Skinner-- to name him as the man inside in the FBI.. Who may have deceived us both. And if I name him, they'll protect me.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Are you going to name him?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Then they'll prosecute you.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah, if they have evidence against me, they know I killed that man.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Even with the ballistics evidence, I can still be the shooter.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Scully, I can't let you take the blame... Because of your brother, because of your mother, and because I couldn't live with it. To live the lie you have to believe it, like these men who deceive us... Who gave you this disease. We all have our faith, and mine is in the truth.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Then why did you come here... If you'd already made up your mind?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Because I knew you'd... Talk me out of it if I was making a mistake.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ door opens ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: You'll be in my prayers.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Have the father say a few "hail mulders" for me, okay?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: If he's a no-show, I'm gonna ask for a bench warrant.
entries.speaker: Senior Agent

entries.text: [ door opens ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I'm sorry I'm late.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Mulder, the assembled members of this review panel... First convened to address your reported death, only to find shortly that this report had been a lie-- that you were indeed very much alive... And that the body found in your apartment, believed to be yours, was a murder victim killed with a weapon... Issued by the FBI and registered to you.
entries.speaker: Scott Blevins

entries.text: Respectfully, sir, I've come here today to set the record straight... So that this process you've begun can be completed, and the guilty parties can be named.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Respectfully, sir, I'd like to ask for a short break.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I'm... Ready to proceed, please, sir.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Go on, agent Mulder.
entries.speaker: Scott Blevins

entries.text: Four years ago, while working on an assignment outside the FBI mainstream, I was paired with special agent Dana Scully, who I believed was sent to spy on me-- to debunk my investigations into the paranormal. That agent Scully did not follow these orders... Is a testament to her integrity as an investigator, a scientist and a human being. She has paid dearly for this integrity.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Mulder, agent Scully lied straight-faced to this panel about your death.
entries.speaker: Scott Blevins

entries.text: She lied because I asked her to. Because I had evidence of a conspiracy-- a conspiracy against the American people.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We've already heard testimony to these allegations, agent Mulder.
entries.speaker: Senior Agent

entries.text: And a conspiracy intended to destroy the lives... Of those who would reveal its true purpose; to conduct experiments on unwitting victims... To further a secret agenda for someone within the government operating at levels... Without restraint or responsibility, without morals or conscious. Men who pretend to honor as they deceive. The price of this betrayal-- the lives and reputations of those deceived. Agent Scully... Is lying in a hospital bed right now diagnosed with terminal cancer. The victim of these same tests, conducted without her knowledge or consent... By these same men who, as they try to cover their tracks, who suborn and persecute the same people they've used in their plot, I will now call by name.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Mulder, did you or did you not shoot the man found dead in your apartment?
entries.speaker: Senior Agent

entries.text: I will answer that question.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Did you shoot scott Ostelhoff, employee of the Department of Defense?
entries.speaker: Senior Agent

entries.text: I will answer that question.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ man ] answer the question asked, agent Mulder!
entries.speaker: Senior Agent

entries.text: I will answer the question after I name the man!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Mulder--
entries.speaker: Senior Agent

entries.text: I will answer that question... After I name the man who is responsible for agent Scully. The same man who directed that my apartment be surveilled by the d.o.d. A man I want to see prosecuted for his crimes, who is sitting in this very room as I speak.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Mulder, the section chief has asked you a question! You are going to answer!
entries.speaker: Senior Agent

entries.text: I can't do that, sir.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You can and you will!
entries.speaker: Senior Agent

entries.text: I can't do that, sir, because the section chief is the man I'm about to name!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ door opens ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ indistinct ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ groans ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: The smoking man's dead.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: How?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Shot through his window. Forensics found it at the scene. We're assuming it's his blood.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Assuming?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Well, no body was found, though there was too much blood lost for anyone to have survived. This afternoon when you named Blevins, how did you know?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I didn't. I just guessed.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Well, it was a hell of a guess. Blevins had been on payroll for four years... To a biotechnology company called Roush, which is somehow connected to all this.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Well, I'm sure whatever connections there were, they're being erased right now.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: They're cleaning up, taking everything away.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Not everything. Scully's cancer's gone into remission.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's unbelievable news.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: It's the best news I could have ever heard.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What turned it around?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I don't know. I don't think we'll ever know.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Can I see her?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Yeah. She's in there with her family right now. But I'm sure she'd love to see you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
